observations.detail: category-evolution-account-filter.ts applies NOT EXISTS Invoice scoped by organizationId and financialProfileId where Invoice.paymentTransactionId = movement.id for all, account, and card source modes.

category-evolution-account-filter.integration.test.ts captures the all-sources expense baseline before settlement, closes and pays the invoice, asserts Invoice.paymentTransactionId equals the returned payment transaction id, retries payment expecting CARD_INVOICE_ALREADY_PAID, creates an unrelated expense with the same amount and same description, and asserts the aggregate grows only by that unrelated expense while the payment-account report contains only that legitimate expense and the selected card remains 2000.

The product diff remains limited to category evolution filter, its integration test, docs/API_REPORTS.md and docs/CARDS.md. The current material head is a child of the previous result-only handoff because CI remediation was appended without rewriting history; the remediation itself changes only the integration test baseline assertion.
docs/CARDS.md and docs/API_REPORTS.md define economic purchase versus cash settlement and prohibit inference by description, value, date, category, or cardId alone.
The exclusion subquery is scoped by both organizationId and financialProfileId, and the existing integration scenario retains cross-organization and cross-profile source rejection checks.
PR 623 is open, mergeable, targets main, and material head edfdb6a9aa74f96c155d12fd8ded19b83ab3cf83 has CI run 32076832295 pending at package construction time.

Previous handoff-head CI run 32076640998 reached the affected integration test and failed only because the new all-sources assertion hard-coded 9000 while assertAccountFilter had already left a legitimate 3000 expense in the same tenant and period. The cycle-2 test now captures the pre-payment baseline and proves settlement adds zero while the same-looking unrelated expense adds exactly one payment amount.
